title: Special Order for Transvac, LLC, ex parte. — Transvac, LLC, ex parte. In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC Nos. 7063 & 7018. THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED LPSC Nos. 7063 & 7018 hereby are, cancelled.

documents.text:
LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION

                           SPECIAL ORDER NUMBER 68-2026

                                      TRANSVAC, LLC
                                        EX PARTE

                    In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC No. 7063 & 7018
On information and belief that the carrier wishes to close LPSC Nos. 7063 & 7018 per a notarized
affidavit received on October 16, 2026, it is therefore ORDERED that LPSC Nos. 7063 & 7018
held by Transvac, LLC are hereby CANCELLED and REVOKED, with all outstanding fees and
fines owed the Commission to be paid by the carrier in the event of any reinstatement.

                                  (Decided October 16, 2026)




BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION
BATON ROUGE, LOUISIANA
October 16, 2026



                                                DISTRICT I
                                                CHAIRMAN ERIC F. SKRMETTA

                                                VICE CHAIRMAN JEAN-PAUL P. COUSSAN
